summary: Full backend + frontend testing of new SEO/share features: /api/share/blog/{slug}, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, RouteSeo per-route metadata, ShareButtons (WhatsApp/LinkedIn/copy), and regressions on Home/Contacto. All acceptance criteria pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py escapes title/desc/image with html.escape but the Python !r repr used in the inline location.replace(...) script would fail to properly escape edge cases like a title containing a literal ' or </script>. Currently safe because slug and share params are query strings under our control, but consider using json.dumps(target) instead of Python repr for the JS string literal to be safer.

share_blog builds target URL from x-forwarded-host / host header without validation; in this preview environment it correctly produces the preview host, but attackers could pass Host header to poison the redirect if backend is exposed directly. Acceptable behind Kubernetes ingress but worth noting.
Seo.jsx uses setMeta which correctly updates existing meta tags (no duplicates); verified only 1 meta[og:title] and 1 meta[name=description] on / and /blog/... pages.

ShareButtons: WhatsApp URL includes the full share URL after the title which contains encoded characters - works fine but the concatenation format 'title url' can be ambiguous with punctuation. Minor UX polish.
seed_data_creation: Only TEST_ contacto rows via existing contacto tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests split across /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (contacto/status) and /app/backend/tests/test_share_and_seo.py (share endpoint, robots, sitemap). Note: link[rel=canonical].href in JS is auto-normalized by the browser (adds trailing slash on root); use getAttribute('href') for exact-match assertions. og:url on Home is intentionally 'https://enlacefintech.com' without trailing slash per seo.js logic. Sitemap currently has 32 <url> entries; adjust the test if you add more.
